title: Distributed Lag Neural Additive Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.07381v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Distributed Lag Neural Additive Models (DLNAMs), neural-additive analogues of Distributed Lag Non-linear Models (DLNMs) for learning nonlinear effects distributed over lags. DLNAMs replace a prespecified spline cross-basis with neural components that learn exposure--lag response surfaces, avoiding choices of basis family, dimension, and knot placement while preserving additive interpretability and familiar distributed-lag summaries. Exp-centered input layers, smooth activations, and learned subnetwork mixtures produce smooth, locally adaptive representations; pointwise uncertainty combines a conditional last-layer Laplace approximation with between-member ensemble variation. In simulations, DLNAMs generally outperformed DLNM comparators, including penalized and treed variants, in recovering known response functions, with lower bias, stronger boundary recovery, and better-calibrated cumulative intervals; gains were largest

translated_title: 分布式滞后神经加性模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了分布式滞后神经加性模型（DLNAMs），它是分布式滞后非线性模型（DLNMs）的神经加性类比，用于学习分布在滞后期的非线性效应。DLNAMs用能够学习暴露-滞后响应面的神经组件取代了预先指定的样条交叉基，从而避免了基函数族、维度和节点位置的选择问题，同时保留了加性可解释性和人们熟悉的分布式滞后摘要统计量。以指数为中心的输入层、平滑激活函数以及学习得到的子网络混合产生了平滑的、局部自适应的表示；逐点不确定性则结合了条件化的最后一层拉普拉斯近似与集成成员间的变异。在模拟实验中，DLNAMs在恢复已知响应函数方面总体优于DLNM对比方法（包括惩罚变体和树状变体），表现出更低的偏差、更强的边界恢复能力以及更好校准的累积置信区间；其优势最大（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出分布式滞后神经加性模型（DLNAM），用神经网络组件替代预先指定的样条交叉基来学习暴露-滞后非线性效应，在保持加性可解释性的同时避免了基函数选择问题，并在模拟中相比传统DLNM实现了更低的偏差、更强的边界恢复能力和更好校准的不确定性估计。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Distributed Lag Neural Additive Models (DLNAMs), which replace prespecified spline cross-bases with neural components to learn exposure-lag response surfaces, outperforming traditional DLNMs in simulations with lower bias, stronger boundary recovery, and better-calibrated uncertainty while preserving additive interpretability.
